source_text: Non assumes nomen Domini in vanum. Memento diem sabbati. Nomen vanum — ore sanctum, vita alienum. Sabbatum — cessatio operum malorum, opus Dei. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Not you-shall-take name of-Lord in vain. Remember day of-sabbath. Name vain — with-mouth holy, with-life alien. Sabbath — cessation of-works evil, work of-God. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[You shall not take the Lord’s name in vain >> Bible:Exodus 20:7]]. [[Remember the sabbath day >> Bible:Exodus 20:8]]. A vain name is holy on the lips and foreign in the life. Sabbath is ceasing evil works to do the work of God. Amen.
